levels.name: Muddled corner
levels.sol: F F R F F
levels.start: F F F F R
levels.hint: Run it and watch. On which square should the robot turn?

levels.name: Topsy-turvy turns
levels.sol: F L F F R F F
levels.start: F R F F L F F
levels.hint: Watch the first corner. Which way should the robot turn there?

levels.name: Turn first
levels.sol: R F L F R F L F
levels.start: F R F L F R F L
levels.hint: Which way is the robot facing? Should it step first, or turn first?

levels.name: Short then long
levels.sol: r2(F) R r5(F)
levels.start: r5(F) R r2(F)
levels.hint: Count the squares in each straight line. Which Repeat goes first?

levels.name: Loop the stairs
levels.sol: r4(F R F L)
levels.start: r4(F) R F L
levels.hint: Only Forward repeats now. Which other blocks make one whole stair?

levels.name: Climb, then stroll
levels.sol: r3(F L F R) F F
levels.start: r3(F L F R F F)
levels.hint: The stairs repeat three times. Does the walk at the top repeat too?

levels.name: Long strides
levels.sol: r2(F F R F F L)
levels.start: r2(F R F F L F)
levels.hint: Look at one big stride. How far along before the robot turns down?

levels.name: Twos and threes
levels.sol: r2(F F) L r3(F) R F
levels.start: r2(F) L r3(F F) R F
levels.hint: Two times what makes the first line? Three times what makes the next?

levels.name: Turns in between
levels.sol: r3(F) R r4(F) L F
levels.start: r3(F R) r4(F L) F
levels.hint: A turn inside a Repeat happens every time. Should these turns repeat?

levels.name: Up, along, down
levels.sol: r3(F L F R) r2(F) R r3(F)
levels.start: r2(F) R r3(F) r3(F L F R)
levels.hint: All the parts are right, but in a muddle. Which part comes first?

levels.name: Horseshoe
levels.sol: r3(R r2(F))
levels.start: r2(R r3(F))
levels.hint: One Repeat sits inside the other. Which number belongs outside?

levels.name: Mountain steps
levels.sol: r3(r2(F) L r2(F) R)
levels.start: r3(r2(F L) r2(F R))
levels.hint: Each big step is two lines and two turns. Should a turn repeat?

levels.name: Tooth by tooth
levels.sol: r3(r2(L F F L) F F)
levels.start: r3(F F r2(L F F L))
levels.hint: The first tooth is right above the robot. Climb first, or walk first?

levels.name: Fishing hook
levels.sol: r2(r4(F) R) r2(r2(F) R)
levels.start: r2(r2(F) R) r2(r4(F) R)
levels.hint: Follow the hook from the robot. Long sides first, or short sides?

levels.name: Nosy robot
levels.sol: r3(F F L F R R F L) R r3(F)
levels.start: r3(F F L F F R R L) R r3(F)
levels.hint: Peek into a nook, then out again. When does the robot turn round?

levels.name: Whirlpool
levels.sol: r3(r6(F) R) r2(r4(F) R) r2(r2(F) R)
levels.start: r2(r6(F) R) r3(r4(F) R) r2(r2(F) R)
levels.hint: Count the sides: how many long ones, middle ones and short ones?

levels.name: F1 in a muddle
levels.sol: f f f|F F R F L
levels.start: f f f|F F L F R
levels.hint: F1 runs the blocks in its own row. Fix that row and every F1 works!

levels.name: Duck pond
levels.sol: r2(f R) f|r2(F) R r3(F) L
levels.start: r2(f) R f|r3(F) R r2(F) L
levels.hint: Each F1 goes round one corner of the pond. How far along, how far down?

levels.name: Winding stairs
levels.sol: f R F f R f|r2(F R F L)
levels.start: f F R f R f|r2(F L F R)
levels.hint: Fix F1's stairs first. Between flights: turn first, or step first?

levels.name: Castle arches
levels.sol: r2(f F F)|L F F R F F R F F L
levels.start: r2(F F f)|L F F R F F L F F R
levels.hint: F1 climbs one arch. Check its turns, then climb first or walk first?
